finalists.label: Hemicrania Continua
finalists.why: The candidate has specific evidence for a right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region.

finalists.label: Migraine
finalists.why: The candidate has strong evidence for a 17-year history of migraine headaches and a visual aura of gray-white spots followed by pain behind the right eye radiating to the right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions.

finalists.label: Chronic Migraine
finalists.why: The candidate has specific evidence for a 17-year history of migraine headaches and 3 to 4 severe migraines per month lasting 3 to 7 days.

finalists.label: Short-Lasting Unilateral Neuralgiform Headache Attacks
finalists.why: The candidate has no evidence against it, but also lacks specific evidence for it.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the strongest and most specific evidence, including a 17-year history of migraine headaches and a visual aura of gray-white spots followed by pain behind the right eye radiating to the right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions.
